opcodes.description: OP_DATA is consumed atomically as the auxiliary operand of its owner opcode and is marked non-landable in the frozen TPDE source CFG.
Exception dispatch is represented as compiler-built MIR exception edges and TPDE exception-block branches; no VM opcode handler is called.
The native entry invokes the registered user callback, interprets its action, and resolves ENTER through the native entry registry.
Dynamic magic-call trampolines are normalized to __call/__callStatic and continue through native user/internal call entries.
